overview_description.description: Aesty is an AI-powered fashion and styling platform that helps users create outfits, organise their wardrobe, and virtually try on clothing using artificial intelligence. The platform analyses a user’s body features, style preferences, and clothing photos to generate personalised outfit recommendations and styling advice.
